anti_cheating_3_strike_rule.policy_name: 3-Strike Tab Switch & WebCam Camera Presence Policy
anti_cheating_3_strike_rule.summary: Candidates are provided a live PIP WebCam Self-Preview in the bottom-right corner and allowed 2 warnings before lockout.
anti_cheating_3_strike_rule.enforcement: A 3-second grace period is allowed. At 3s absence, a soft yellow warning banner & Web Audio chime alert the candidate. At 15s, a red strike warning is issued. 3 strikes terminate the session.
anti_cheating_3_strike_rule.evidence_logging: Exact timestamp, out-of-frame duration, audio chime triggers, and face presence confidence levels are logged in the Security Timeline.

plagiarism_detection_thresholds.summary: Take-home code submissions and interview transcripts are cross-checked against GitHub and historical candidates.
plagiarism_detection_thresholds.enforcement: Submissions exceeding 75% similarity trigger an automatic 'Copy Risk' tag and hold stage advancement.

speaking_audio_environment.summary: Candidates must enable microphone access and maintain a quiet background during AI interview rounds.
speaking_audio_environment.enforcement: If speech recognition fails after 2 retries, the candidate is switched to Speech Fallback mode with zero penalty.

candidate_termination_policy.summary: Candidates are terminated from an assessment if 3 tab-switch strikes or 3 camera out-of-frame strikes occur.
candidate_termination_policy.enforcement: Terminated assessments receive a 0 score and generate a recruiter risk notification badge.
